_about: Red Flag Theory Season 1 cast (roster 1–40, NotebookLM source 2). A person = base face + one face candidate + one outfit; accessories (glasses, earrings, headband, headset) belong to the face. Every outfit keeps the signature colour on its main piece. New people's signature colours are proposals. Generated 2 Nov 2026. Ak picked faces and outfits on 2026-11-03: see each person's "chosen" (fewer outfits on purpose, for recognisability). Geo-minimal eyes: own white eyes with lids.
